verdict.rationale: Retell's built-in AI assistant, Conductor, covers the story. It drafts an agent from a plain-English description via "Generate from prompt" [retell-docs-30]. It also edits prompts, settings and conversation flows from plain-language requests, proposing changes for review before they are applied [retell-docs-53, retell-docs-54]. It can run simulation tests that play out scenarios against the agent [retell-docs-55]. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that Conductor generates test cases from a description (the docs only say it runs simulation tests), and any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
